notes.title: New boss fights and in game save !
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone ![/p][p][/p][p]Life has kept me busy, but I’m still hard at work on [i]Rogunky[/i]! I’ve recently added [b]in-game saving[/b], [b]redesigned the title screen[/b], and started packing the game with [b]tons of new items and secrets[/b] for you to discover.[/p][p]Here’s a sneak peek at the brand new title screen:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194449/267489777846cbae587bac54482e6a109fe5ec7a.png"][/img][/p][p]I leave you with some new bosses fights, more updates soon![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194449/f656b9b9a24154f9148d9360016e5a5c2900b5ae.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194449/c36a8e1e4e27c1fb88aec98c873b2628a0eb8e4c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194449/4857222c4c92001bfb8456d9470b696460f02837.png"][/img][/p]
